caption: The drawing consists of a horizontal strip placed near the center of an otherwise plain beige background. The strip features a green central band adorned with a repeating pattern of light green, stylized floral or starburst motifs. Above the green band is a thin black line followed by a gray band and a row of white, crescent-shaped or dotted marks on a gray background. Below the green band, the design is bordered by a thin black line, a slightly thicker white band, and then another thin black line. In the lower right corner of the beige background, the name "GEORGE ROBIN" is written in small capital letters.
title: Wall Paper Border
